summary: One open repository dataset covers the subject directly: the Dryad 'Turing's Sunflowers' release (CC0, 657 annotated sunflower heads with parastichy counts and annotated images). It has counts but no tabulated crossing angles, so angles would have to be measured from the 315 MB image archive. GBIF and iDigBio hold tens of thousands of Helianthus annuus images but are not curated for face-on seed heads, and nothing covers other capitula.
next_step: Download the Dryad image zip outside the scouting budget, check what the annotations encode (seed centres or spiral lines), and pre-register an angle-extraction rule and a threshold for 'near 90 degrees' before measuring.
obstacles_confirmed: Only Helianthus annuus (one species, mostly cultivated) has an open annotated head set.
No repository table of intersection angles; they must be derived from images.
